events.text:
The ripple's numbers were already out of date, so I updated T-229's live-state line and evidence link to the current Worker. The fix itself still works on production, and T-229 stays in review.

**Completion check:**
- **Ripple (bring T-229's live-state lines up to date):** done. The ripple quoted Worker 9761eae3 and 26 attendees, but `wrangler deployments list` shows production now runs Worker 3dc17ab7. The note and evidence link now point at `?v=3dc17ab7`. Commit 51c7ee1 (the subdomain fix) is on origin/main.
- **Attendee 5 marked test, no failed Zoom rows for real attendees:** met. On production, attendee 5 returns 404 (it no longer exists). Of the 33 attendees, none with an `example.*` address is left unmarked as test. The admin's calendar status shows no Zoom or Google sync rows, so Zoom failed is 0.
- **/cal/issue and /intake with an example.com address create nothing:** passed on production in this run. I posted `[email]` to both and got the usual 200 answers (feed null). The attendee count stayed at 33 and the highest id at 141. Those two posts used a subdomain of example.com, the case fix 51c7ee1 added.
- **probe-calendar-feeds passes with the refusal check:** not re-run this run, because the ripple only concerned the live-state lines and no code changed. The last result is 67 of 67 from the previous run's fresh local stack.

I changed no code, so I made no commit. The only edit is the task record in `tasks.json`, which the runner will commit. The ripple note R-e6656443 is acknowledged.

To check it yourself, open https://revops-centre.growthcluborg.workers.dev/admin/?v=3dc17ab7#settings, then Cohort Settings, then Invite Status.
